feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump touts 'energy ceasefire,' after urging Ukrainians to ditch Zelenskyy
entry.summary: Ukraine's President Zelenskyy warns Trump's decision to ease Russian diesel sanctions could fuel Moscow's war effort as the U.S. president urges Ukraine to find new leadership.

entry.title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire about President Trump's deal for Russian diesel and his claim of an "energy ceasefire" that did not materialize.

entry.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
entry.summary: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

entry.title: Republican strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Republican strategist Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.

entry.title: Trump struggles to show voters he's focused on the cost of living
entry.summary: With a deal to import millions of tons of diesel fuel from Russia, President Trump is struggling to show voters that he is focused on the cost of living ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: Oil-heated households in Northeast strained by rising fuel prices
entry.summary: Rising fuel prices are stressing household budgets in the Northeast, where many rely on heating oil to warm their homes.

entry.title: What Trump's new press secretary pick means for White House press corps
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with New York Times White House correspondent Tyler Pager about President Trump's new pick for press secretary, Katie Zacharia.

entry.title: After Hurricane Isaias on Gulf Coast, storms affect Pacific coast
entry.summary: Alabama and the Florida Panhandle bore the brunt of Hurricane Isaias. While the storm weakened once it hit land, four people lost their lives. Meanwhile, other storms are affecting the Pacific coast.

entry.title: Texas' 15th Congressional District provides clues to state's Latino vote
entry.summary: The 15th Congressional District runs from the east of San Antonio all the way down into the Rio Grande Valley. This majority-Latino district provides a window into the Latino vote in Texas.
